Dear Sir(s)/Madam(s), 
 
Sub: Outcome of Interaction with the Analysts/Institutional Investors - Regulation 30 of the 
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
 
This is further to our letter dated October 26, 2026, wherein we had intimated the Stock Exchanges 
regarding schedule of the Earnings Conference Call with the Analysts/Institutional Investors.  
 
In compliance with  Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that The Phoenix Mills Limited 
(“Company”) has today viz. Saturday, October 31, 2026, concluded its Earnings Conference call with 
the Analysts/Institutional Investors at 12:28 P.M. (IST) on the Unaudited Standalone and 
Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
The Financial Results and the Investor Presentation, as submitted to the Stock Exchanges vide our
